title: Live replies · {name}
label: Send replies as Claude writes them
detail_on: The web and the iPhone and Mac apps get each reply line by line, seconds sooner
detail_off: Replies show up once Claude saves them
footer: When on, the Claude Code sessions Persona starts on this computer send their replies while Claude writes them, so the web and the Persona apps on iPhone and Mac show the text sooner. The cost: in this computer's terminal, replies appear a few lines at a time instead of word by word. The hub keeps this switch, not ~/.claude/settings.json; with “Change all online machines” on above, the other online computers change too. A change applies to sessions started after it; a session that is already running changes once Claude restarts.
